1) Scenario (production-shaped)

Checkout chain under load. Inventory stock lookup hits a real KeyError (SKU missing from WAREHOUSE_SKU_INDEX — not a fail-flag). Callers return bad gateway. From Datadog’s point of view this is an error-rate increase across three services — not a single packaged Incident.

Trace tree — ERROR leaf
FEGET /api/checkout → 502 status:error
ProductGET /api/product → 502 status:error
LeafGET /api/stock → 500 KeyError

Leaf = code bug on inventory — upstream 502s are symptoms.

Inject./scripts/break_inventory_code.sh (drop WIDGET-1)
Heal./scripts/heal_inventory_code.sh

2) What the app emits (all three rails)

Metrics

APM auto: trace.flask.request.hits / .errors / duration.
Custom DogStatsD: rca.inventory.stock.errors, rca.checkout.errors, rca.product.upstream.errors, timings rca.*.duration.

Traces

ddtrace distributed trace FE→product→inventory. Leaf span: error=1, error.type=KeyError, error.message, http.status_code:500 (code-level missing catalog key).

Logs

JSON file + stdout per service under logs/<service>.log. Fields: event, http_status, sku, dd.trace_id / dd.span_id for log↔trace join. Agent tails via rca_lab_logs.d.

Tagging (Unified Service Tags) stamps service / env / version on every rail — that is the join key for Related and explorers. See Thesis §3.2.

3) How each rail sees this KeyError

ERROR-specific view of the three product stores — not a pipeline stage walk (that is Three-rail journey).

3.1 Metrics rail

Error rate is a ratio series, not a single event. APM: trace.flask.request.errors / hits by {env,service} → ~1.0 on inventory during fault. Custom: sum:rca.inventory.stock.errors{env:rca-lab-e3}.as_count() rises in lockstep. Monitors query these series (Door A).
SeriesHealthyFaultUsed by
trace.flask.request.errors/hits~0~1.0Auto High Error Rate monitor
rca.inventory.stock.errors0↑ countCustom Detect / dashboards
rca.checkout.errors0↑ countEdge symptom series

3.2 Traces (APM) rail

Spans are the ground truth for where on the call path. All three services show status:error; only inventory is the leaf 500 / KeyError. Service Map peers come from these spans — derived view, not a dual write fabric.
Span fieldLeaf (inventory)Upstream
http.status_code500502
error.typeKeyErrorUpstream*Error
Code causeWIDGET-1 missing from indexcascade only

3.3 Logs rail

Logs explain why in human/text form and corroborate the leaf. Example inventory line: event:inventory.stock.error, http_status:500, error_type:KeyError, plus dd.trace_id to open the same flamegraph.
{"level":"ERROR","message":"stock lookup KeyError — catalog key missing", "service":"inventory","env":"rca-lab-e3","event":"inventory.stock.error", "http_status":500,"sku":"WIDGET-1","error_type":"KeyError", "dd.trace_id":"…","dd.span_id":"…"}

5) Correlate one request (M∥T∥L)

  1. Metrics — see error_rate / rca.*.errors spike for service:inventory first-or-equal with callers.
  2. Traces — open an error trace; read deepest span (500 + KeyError).
  3. Logs — from the span, jump via dd.trace_id (or search @event:inventory.stock.error) to the JSON reason line.
  4. Related — keep env:rca-lab-e3 + time window constant across explorers.
Do not stop at frontend 502. Edge symptoms light up on all three rails; the leaf is inventory KeyError.

7) Flamegraph leaf (operator RCA)

Datadog does not emit rootCauseEntity for this path. The production operator move:

  1. Sort error traces by service / status.
  2. Open a failing checkout trace.
  3. Select the deepest error span (inventory 500 / KeyError).
  4. Confirm with log KeyError and metric rca.inventory.stock.errors.

Upstream 502s + rca.checkout.errors + checkout error logs are symptoms.

9) Bits (peer tab — Observed)

Same spine as this workbook (sticky Bits). Hypothesis loop + 500 vs 502 ranking: Bits · example investigation 90a88d93… (env:rca-lab-e3 · version:keyerror-20260810T072333Z).

Bits can open from Watchdog / APM and correctly cite fault-time version · image · container_id. Lab Python no longer stamps fault.injected — expect KeyError / HTTP 500 wording, not “fault injection”. On Breakdown stages 07–11 use ❚❚ Pause while reading ranking cards.

Heal recreates the inventory container → live ID ≠ Bits’ fault-time ID (165bbcad… for the 2026-08-10 window). Filter out retired envs rca-lab and rca-lab-e2.

Breakdown forks: lean 8-stage Breakdown (cards under each animation).
